assessment_rules: The grade of the group project assigned to each participant will be affected by their performance in the individual exam. Students only need to repeat failed parts, and the mark of passed parts will be maintained. In the extraordinary assessment for Part II, only the exam counts, and the group project will not be considered, making the Exam Chapters 3-4-5 worth 40%.
